answer: Harberger-taxed reef slots stop bulk fakes: each identity posts one opal tag. Each epoch the holder pays 5% tax, burned; anyone may buy the slot at that price. Low tags get bought out; high tags burn tax. A juniper log records tag changes, flagging rings whose tags move together. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 tags at 200: 200,000 locked, 10,000 tax an epoch, against a 40,000 pool. Rented tags fail; honest agents pay 10 an epoch, keep a full share.
